license: Same as DAS Sentinel repository (internal). No third-party template redistribution.
profile_note: Every template is a single benign GET with matchers only — NO payloads, fuzzing, brute-force, or OOB/interactsh. Fits the default safe-active envelope (CLAUDE.md §2.3). Intrusive/dos/fuzz templates are excluded at runtime as defence-in-depth (-exclude-tags).
digest_note: The bundle content digest is computed from the template files at runtime and recorded on every scanner_run as rules_digest (no floating registry pack is ever fetched — CLAUDE.md §3).
